news.html: One paper has been submitted to ECCV 2026.
One paper has been submitted to ICML 2026.
Joined DJI as a Research Scientist Intern, focusing on image retouching and aesthetic agents.
Received the 2025 Outstanding Technical Cooperation Project award from Huawei.
Restore Anything with Masks: Leveraging Mask Image Modeling for Blind All-in-One Image Restoration has been released on Github!
The official code of Restore Anything with Masks: Leveraging Mask Image Modeling for Blind All-in-One Image Restoration has been released on Github!
One paper got accepted by ECCV 2024!

researchLine.title: Mask image modeling for restoration
researchLine.text: Started from blind all-in-one image restoration, using masked reconstruction as a compact route toward stronger degradation representation.

researchLine.title: Adaptive representations under mixed degradations
researchLine.text: Extended restoration representation learning toward adaptive masks, mixed tasks, and out-of-distribution degradation generalization.

researchLine.title: From restoration models to imaging workflows
researchLine.text: Connecting RAW restoration, diffusion prior into practical computational photography systems.

researchLine.title: Reconstruction-aware visual representations
researchLine.text: Exploring representation autoencoders and reconstruction fidelity as bridges between generative modeling and visual understanding.
